spec.name: Paintball Burst Shooter
spec.description: An elongated sporting paintball marker with charcoal polymer construction, paired orange racing stripes, a stepped oval hopper, silver pressure cylinder and rubber grip. Modest barrel, rounded equipment silhouette and no text or military motifs. Forward is -Z; the centered grip provides the anchor for right-hand item placement.
